fact: POTRAZ's Director General stated on 24 January 2026 that Zimbabwe has no standalone cyber crimes act, and that cybercrime offences (hacking, data interference, cyber-bullying, child abuse material and others, ss.163-168) are in force in Part VIII of the Criminal Law (Codification and Reform) Act [Chapter 9:23], as amended in 2021.
